summary: Innovation Beverage Group Ltd (IBG) filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release from its 51%-owned subsidiary BlockFuel Energy, Inc., announcing the acquisition of a six-well oil and gas package in Payne County, Oklahoma. The deal includes four producing horizontal wells, one drilled uncompleted well, and one saltwater disposal well plus infrastructure. No price per share, premium, or total consideration is disclosed. The board recommends the transaction; IBG also has a proposed merger with BlockFuel. The acquisition adds to BlockFuel's 55-well footprint and includes an eight-well vertical drilling program planned for H2 2026. Watch for merger completion and regulatory approvals affecting the subsidiary structure.
